Class LimitedDataBufferList

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<DataBuffer>
java.util.AbstractList<DataBuffer>
java.util.ArrayList<DataBuffer>
org.springframework.core.io.buffer.LimitedDataBufferList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<DataBuffer>, Collection<DataBuffer>, List<DataBuffer>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<DataBuffer>
public class LimitedDataBufferList extends ArrayList<DataBuffer>
Custom List to collect data buffers with and enforce a limit on the total number of bytes buffered. For use with "collect" or other buffering operators in declarative APIs, for example, Flux.

添加元素会增加字节计数，如果超出限制，将抛出DataBufferLimitException。clear()会重置计数。不支持移除和设置操作。

注意： 该类不会自动释放其包含的缓冲区。通常更优选使用诸如Flux.doOnDiscard(Class, Consumer)之类的钩子，这些钩子也能处理取消和错误信号，或者否则可以使用releaseAndClear()。

Since:
